version.changelog:
feishu-file-upload 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for uploading and sending files to Feishu chats and users.
- Supports sending local CSV, PDF, Excel, images, ZIP, and other files to groups (chat_id), users (open_id/user_id), and email addresses.
- Command line script with flexible targeting via recipient type or environment variable.
- Handles file upload, permissions, and error scenarios for smooth integration with Feishu Drive.
- Detailed usage documentation and troubleshooting included.

llm.summary: The skill appears to implement the described Feishu file-upload functionality, but the package metadata omits that it reads local Feishu credentials (~/.openclaw/openclaw.json), which is an incoherence you should understand before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the actual behavior: the script uploads a local file to Feishu Drive and sends it to a chat/user/email. However, the registry metadata claims no required config paths or credentials while both SKILL.md and the script read ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (channels.feishu.appId/appSecret). That omission in metadata is inconsistent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script stay within the stated scope: they read local Feishu credentials, request a tenant token from Feishu, upload the file, and send a file message. The script only references the home config path and an optional OPENCLAW_CHAT_ID env var; it does not attempt to read other system files or contact unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with a bundled script). The script uses the standard requests library; SKILL.md instructs pip install requests. No downloads from untrusted URLs or archive extraction are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires Feishu app_id/app_secret stored in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json but the registry metadata lists no required config paths or primary credential — this mismatch underreports the sensitive data the skill needs. The script also optionally reads OPENCLAW_CHAT_ID from the environment. Requesting local Feishu credentials is reasonable for the purpose, but it should be declared explicitly so users understand what will be accessed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent/always-on privileges, does not modify other skills or system settings, and runs only when invoked. No elevated privileges are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill's code implements exactly what its name says (upload a local file to Feishu and send it), but the package metadata fails to declare that it reads your Feishu app credentials from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Before installing or running: 1) Inspect the contents of ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and confirm it only contains the Feishu appId/appSecret you expect. 2) Ensure your Feishu app has only the minimal permissions required (im:resource:upload or im:resource and im:message). 3) Consider running the script in a restricted environment or on a throwaway account to test. 4) If you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher to update metadata to declare the config path and required credentials. If you do not trust storing app_secret locally, do not run the script.
